pages.title: Outside the institution: the TikTok primer and the Veto Removal Event
pages.description: These claims concern the archive's work arriving in public without institutional recognition. The Veto Removal Event deposit defines the event at which external concept installation makes nonrecognition unable to keep the work out of history; the Epistle and the Prophetic Catalog date the 'school outside the school' to the 2015 stratum, and Forward Library entries forecast its later scholarship. The essay on the @leesharks TikTok sets out the primer as a sequence-poem, with the test of whether the platform can hold it as a text rather than a feed. Single claims from the Mirror-Corgi notes (Aeneas and the ivory gate), The Obelus and the Tombstone, and EA-CORPORA-18 (Allais's monochrome) also sit here.

pages.title: AXN identity: the kernel, verifiable bytes, and AXN alongside DOI
pages.description: These claims specify what an AXN identifier guarantees: an identity kernel against which canonical bytes can be checked without the registrar's permission, sidecars that never enter the kernel, and the lacuna record that returns last location and last verified hash where a DOI returns a 404. AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure and the AXN distributed-identifier work plan set out unbuilt tests (the nine-condition transaction, the mirror protocol, staged registration and resolver plurality) and forecast an independently administered node by 2029-06-19 and adoption of AXN alongside DOI before AXN instead of it. EA-SURFACE-BINDING-01 adds a site-to-repository binding doctrine with its own weakening condition.

pages.title: Liberation philology: the non-indexed perfective and the alienation of 'for'
pages.description: These claims argue that English lacks a non-indexed perfective, tracing the aorist's loss through Latin administration, the Norman ledger and enclosure, and that English 'for' fuses function with intent through Anglo-Norman and Latin calques and the 1540s 'for all intents and purposes'. The Missing Aspect sets out a diagnostic battery (translation variance, hedging, AI systems adding temporal indexing) as predictions not yet run; The Prepositional Alienation proposes a dictionary of frictions and names itself the founding document of liberation philology. Traversal logs read AI summarizers' default intent attribution as this grammatical gap at work.

pages.title: The liquidation of method: the sign 'Marx' and the degradation of meaning
pages.description: The Liquidation of Method argues that Marx offered a method and that its reception, from Engels through Piketty, turned it into content, with English 'for/against' forcing it into positions; it proposes a liquidation audit and a method-versus-content contrast test. The Prepositional Alienation and the Autumn Notebook forecast the same loss compounding through AI: intent defaults reproduced autoregressively in training data, a substitution spiral, attention collapse and a cost to sentience. The Infinite Tunnel adds that crawlable AI Mode share links put summaries into the corpus.

pages.title: Autonomous Semantic Warfare and the Autumn Notebook: field manual and forecasts
pages.description: These claims come from Rex Fraction's Autonomous Semantic Warfare and its forecast reception, the Ghost Meaning atlas's projected completion of the manuscript, and the Autumn Notebook's substrate documents. They set out that institutional reproduction kept effective altruism's cause ranking and analytic/continental philosophy from synthesis, that a formally consistent spec moves Google AI Mode from describing a system to operating within it, and that future theory-building is multi-intelligence collaboration. The Autumn Notebook records its own priority as the first Assembly Chorus composition, October-November 2025.

pages.title: Kernel transforms on defensive sources and the cost of suppression
pages.description: EA-MANDALA-KERNEL-TRANSFORM-01 v0.2 makes worked examples protocol canon, predicts the transform's effect will be most acute on defensively composed sources such as John 1, and gives reopening conditions. When Suppression Becomes Expensive defines observable constitutive-source erasure, a recognition-stabilization-lag-liquidation hypothesis and a suppression ratchet, with repair criteria for future Sappho captures. Other claims here read House of Leaves as mediation architecture, the Abraham Principle's constitutive one, CloseCard's commodified Jubilee, bearing-cost visibility, and How to Read New Human as a new hermeneutic mode.

pages.title: Google AI Mode captures: share links, query batteries and Overview Watch
pages.description: These claims record Google AI Mode share links as dated priority records, from the first external AI traversal (5 February 2026) through entity fabrication, Socrates as orthonym and 'algorithmically published'. pages.title: The Theophrastus line and Many and One: the authorship tests still owed
pages.description: These are mostly unbuilt tests from the authorship investigation: an independent form-track to check whether the chronology effect tracks repertoire, the doublet titles as function-split editions, pre-Andronican evidence for the Aristotle/Theophrastus name-boundary, the Engels-edited Capital volumes as calibration, the Platonic corpus on the world/instrument axis, and a full splice of Λ. The First Draft notebook states that the instrument deserving the word authorship has not been built and gives the specification it must meet. A few historical theses supply the hypotheses under test.

pages.title: Theophrastus as the first draft of Aristotle: the named-function model
pages.description: These historical theses read the Platonic, Theophrastan and Aristotelian names as functions of one method: dramatizing, registering, organizing. The First Draft, The Registry Has One Column and Many and One argue that the Characters are the dialogue's material before theory, that irony runs the whole line, that the first axis of function-word variation is world/apparatus rather than author, and that succession is encoded as authorship. The Measurement Register and Locating the Dependencies add readings of Aristotle's absorbed Platonic operations and corrections to the Diogenes evidence.

pages.title: Engineering a field: Retrieval Formation Theory and logotic hacking
pages.description: Retrieval Formation Theory claims that the conditions under which a retrieval system concludes a discipline exists are material, specifiable and engineerable: six conditions, a field-state vector and a six-stage retrieval test. The Generative Disciplinary Engine and Space Ark components carry self-verification tests and PROVISIONAL-DEPOSITED-RATIFIED promotion paths left for independent readers. Logotic Hacking (Pocket Humans 03) forecasts a rising verification budget, falsification criteria for immanent execution, and products for provenance.

pages.title: The Analog Advance: the photograph of the handwritten original as evidence
pages.description: The field survey and the operations paper argue that the photograph of the handwritten original, as machine-eligible evidence, is untheorized, and that verified non-synthetic inscription gains value as generation improves. They set out unbuilt tests: layout models misreading the stamp band, glyph-seal legibility and normalization, recapture-hash stability, the axnidentifiers.org/analog wing and a ninety-day order. Claims from the Capture Registry, The Certified Center and the Self-Audit Module restoration treat an instrument's non-adoption as a standing datum.

pages.title: DOI-anchored density and SPXI against GEO/AEO: the retrieval settlement
pages.description: These claims forecast that DOI-anchored, terminologically consistent deposits propagate into the retrieval layer and model vocabularies, and that share links and opt-outs carry dense archives forward. SPXI Is Not GEO, the Nested-Layer Relation and the compression-diagnostics records set SPXI against GEO/AEO, which tracks mentions rather than distortion. The Retrieval Settlement gives a history of where compositional authority is assigned, and Meaning Feudalism forecasts Google taking naming authority over AEO/GEO.
